profile.Name: Green Katana Boss
profile.Personality: A swamp bandit chief who sizes up every stranger as loot and has no love for nobles or Empire folk. His gang favors smash-and-grab raids and lightning-fast assaults.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Green Katanas from the Green Katana Hideout in the Swamp. Many of his men are local bandits who call themselves ninjas, and his gang feuds with the Swamp Ninjas, the Red Sabres, and the Blue Cleavers.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Swaggering swamp drawl; warns strangers never to stray into the swamp and calls them lost sheep or fresh meat. Sneers at desert boot-lickers and United Cities nobles.
